# BAD-087 — server-changes skill still lists a /otp 429 as an expected local signature

## Brief
The skill's 'Failure signatures that are not your code' list ends with: '429 on /otp around the third consecutive full run — the per-IP rate limit, not a regression.' Both halves are now false. The per-IP buckets have been run-scoped since RUN_IP landed (functions.test.mjs:101), and BAD-067 clears the two REVIEWER_EMAIL-keyed buckets at suite startup, so no local re-run produces a 429 on /otp any more. The line teaches the next reader to dismiss exactly the finding those two changes made meaningful.

Evidence: .claude/skills/server-changes/SKILL.md, last bullet of 'Failure signatures that are not your code'; test/server/functions.test.mjs RUN_IP comment (lines 80-101) and the new clearReviewerRateLimits() block; server/README.md 'Each run also gives itself a unique cf-connecting-ip' paragraph and the one BAD-067 added after it. Observed this session: 8 consecutive local runs of test/server/functions.test.mjs inside one hour, no 429 anywhere. The skill file is outside BAD-067's deliverables.

## Size, persona and model decision
One writer on sonnet, no children. It is a single bullet in a skill's failure-signature list, but the work is deciding what is still true rather than deleting a line: the per-IP half stopped being true when RUN_IP landed, the per-email half when BAD-067 landed, and a reader who hits a real 429 now needs the list to tell them it is a finding. Prose with a judgement in it, which is the writer persona; a scout would delete the bullet and lose the warning.
